prompt: Slow cinematic dolly-in starting from a wide-angle view of the entire workspace, camera moves steadily forward at walking pace through the room toward the silver laptop on the desk in the middle distance. Anamorphic shallow depth of field shifts naturally as we approach. Subtle ambient motion: dust particles drift in light beams from window, slight micro-shift in warm lighting.
